description: This PHP source file defines the KpiModel class within the OrangeHRM Performance plugin. The class models a KPI (Key Performance Indicator), providing serialization and normalization functionalities, and includes methods for constructing the object and converting it to an array for API responses. It uses traits for common serialization behaviors and service access, referencing external entities like Kpi and related services.

classes.name: KpiModel
classes.description: A model class representing KPI data for the API layer, capable of serialization, normalization, and including business logic about KPI deletability.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a KPI entity, setting filters and attribute names for serialization.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the KPI model to an array, adding the 'deletable' status based on business logic.
